title: Introduce compact-delta aggregator and span-primer sampling with contextual alert gating
author: Nikhil Rao
description: Context and motivation: We currently surface token-level cost and latency breakdowns and long-tail alerts, but we lack a compact, query-efficient signal that captures the delta between streamed/committed tokens and final generator decision sequences across invocations. This causes noisy alerts for streaming-heavy routes and makes it hard to prioritize log capture for expensive anomalies. This PR introduces two orthogonal improvements: (1) a compact-delta aggregator (stream-delta-meter) that computes a lightweight fingerprint and byte/ token delta histogram per invocation, suitable for rollups; and (2) a span-primer sampler that prefetches higher-fidelity logs and span context for invocations whose compact-delta signatures match configured entropy or pattern thresholds. On top of those we add a contextual alert gating policy (quiet_gate) that reduces alert churn by conditioning alerts on delta stability and recent run-rate of similar fingerprints. Summary of changes: - Introduce stream-delta-meter: a runtime-side metric that emits per-invocation compact hashes, token delta counts (prefetch vs commit), and a small entropy score. Aggregates are designed for rollup storage (low cardinality keys + reservoir histograms). - Add span-primer sampler: a lightweight pre-sampler integrated into the observability sidecar which, given a fingerprint and entropy, will pre-attach a small log buffer and request span enrichment only for candidates above a configurable threshold. The sampler is tunable per-tenant and per-route. - Add quiet_gate alert conditioning: a filter that subscribes to compact-delta rollups and SLO state; alerts are muted for short windows when matched fingerprints have stable low-entropy behavior, and re-enabled when variance increases. - Dashboard additions: new panels in observability/default-invocations.json showing compact-delta heatmap, delta-to-cost scatter, and primer hit-rate. - Tests and benchmarks: unit tests for aggregator, e2e system test with synthetic streaming traces, and a small perf benchmark to ensure meter adds <1% p99 overhead under 1000req/s on local bench. Design notes and rationale: - Compact deltas are intentionally lossy: we trade exact reconstruction for low-cardinality signal useful at scale. The hash + histogram allows joining to traces when we escalate only for interesting patterns. - Span-primer reduces log storage and rate of expensive span hydration by steering enrichment to likely-high-value invocations. - quiet_gate is a pragmatic middle-ground between strict suppression and noisy alerts; tuned conservatively by default. Checklist: - [x] runtime metric implementation and unit tests - [x] sidecar sampler + integration tests - [x] dashboard panels and example queries - [x] alert rule + default gating policy - [x] perf benchmark and basic throughput test Deployment plan: staged rollout by tenant: 1) feature off by default in main; 2) enable for internal telemetry-qa tenant and observe primer hit-rate; 3) ramp to canary for <10% of traffic on observability namespace with quiet_gate in monitoring-only mode; 4) flip gating to active after 48h stable canary. Rollback: feature flags at runtime for both stream-delta-meter and span-primer; quiet_gate can be disabled centrally. Backwards compatibility: metric schema adds a v2 tag; aggregators fall back to v1 path when v2 not present. Related work: this complements existing prefetch-warmup-metrics (pr-577890) but focuses on compact fingerprints and gating rather than prefetch efficiency. Also ties into token-cost-atlas efforts for downstream attribution. Review notes: reviewers asked for clear cardinality constraints and privacy review for hashing; hashing scheme uses HMAC with tenant key and is documented in SECURITY.md. Performance testing and CI: CI run passed (unit/integration/linters). Benchmarks included microbench script results in /observability/bench/compact_delta/bench.md. Post-merge action items: (1) add a telemetry dashboard to SLO-runbook linking primer hits to alert history, (2) schedule a short playbook with oncall to observe quiet_gate behavior for first week.

Author reply: lowered default sensitivity and added feature flag for aggressive gating.
release_notes: Added compact-delta aggregator and a context-aware span primer sampler to reduce observability noise and improve targeted log capture. Includes new dashboard panels and an alert gating policy to reduce churn. Disabled by default; staged rollout required.
